config.title: Project Deck
config.baseFolders: Folders or glob patterns scanned for Git repositories and `.code-workspace` files.
config.ignoredFolders: Folder names or glob patterns skipped while scanning.
config.maxDepthRecursion: How deep the scanner looks into each base folder.
config.groupBy: How the project list is grouped: by path, tag, remote organization or not at all.
config.pathGroupDepth: Which path segment below a base folder becomes the group name.
config.tags: Tags offered when assigning project tags.
config.multiTagGroups: When grouping by tag, list a project in every group it belongs to.
config.sortList: Order of projects inside each group.
config.showGitStatus: Show the branch, ahead/behind and working-tree state on each project.
config.concurrency: How many repositories are inspected in parallel.
config.openInNewWindow: Open projects in a new window by default.
config.statusBar: Show the current project and branch in the status bar.
